meta.description: Structured bucket library for the CHOICE root-word matching pipeline. tier 1 = short single-line prompts used for the 5-line tooltip. tier 2 = deeper strategic prompts synthesizing PESTLE/Porter's/SWOT/Ansoff/STP/JTBD/VPC.
meta.note_on_duplicates: Value Proposition, Product Strategy, and Continuous Improvement appear in both tiers with different prompt depth. Kept as separate entries (different ids) — decide in build brief §2 how they combine.

tier_1_buckets.name: Customer
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider customer segment, persona, needs, pain points, and expected outcomes.

tier_1_buckets.name: Value Proposition
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider the core value being created and why it matters.

tier_1_buckets.name: Problem Definition
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider whether the problem is clearly defined, measurable, and validated.

tier_1_buckets.name: Business Objective
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider target business outcomes, KPIs, and success criteria.

tier_1_buckets.name: Market
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider market size, maturity, growth, and dynamics.

tier_1_buckets.name: Competition
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider competitors, substitutes, and differentiation.

tier_1_buckets.name: Pricing
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider pricing strategy, willingness to pay, and monetization.

tier_1_buckets.name: Revenue
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider revenue streams and commercial impact.

tier_1_buckets.name: Cost
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider implementation, operational, and lifecycle costs.

tier_1_buckets.name: ROI
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider expected benefits versus investment required.

tier_1_buckets.name: Stakeholders
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider all relevant stakeholders and their interests.

tier_1_buckets.name: User Journey
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider the end-to-end user journey and friction points.

tier_1_buckets.name: Customer Experience
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider usability, satisfaction, and delight.

tier_1_buckets.name: Technology
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider technical feasibility, architecture, and constraints.

tier_1_buckets.name: Data
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider required data, quality, ownership, and governance.

tier_1_buckets.name: AI/ML
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider whether AI is needed and how model quality will be measured.

tier_1_buckets.name: Security
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider security risks, controls, and access management.

tier_1_buckets.name: Privacy
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider privacy, compliance, and sensitive information.

tier_1_buckets.name: Legal
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider legal obligations and regulatory requirements.

tier_1_buckets.name: Risk
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider key risks, assumptions, and mitigation plans.

tier_1_buckets.name: Dependencies
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider upstream and downstream dependencies.

tier_1_buckets.name: Resources
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider people, budget, tools, and infrastructure.

tier_1_buckets.name: Timeline
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider milestones, sequencing, and delivery dates.

tier_1_buckets.name: Change Management
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider adoption, communication, and training.

tier_1_buckets.name: Operations
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider operational readiness and support.

tier_1_buckets.name: Scalability
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider growth, performance, and future expansion.

tier_1_buckets.name: Reliability
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider resilience, availability, and failure scenarios.

tier_1_buckets.name: Performance
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider latency, throughput, and optimization.

tier_1_buckets.name: Quality
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider quality standards and acceptance criteria.

tier_1_buckets.name: Innovation
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider opportunities for innovation or simplification.

tier_1_buckets.name: Sustainability
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider environmental and long-term sustainability factors.

tier_1_buckets.name: Ethics
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider fairness, bias, and ethical implications.

tier_1_buckets.name: Accessibility
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider inclusivity and accessibility requirements.

tier_1_buckets.name: Localization
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider language, geography, and cultural adaptations.

tier_1_buckets.name: Supply Chain
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider suppliers, procurement, and logistics.

tier_1_buckets.name: Sales
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider sales enablement and commercial execution.

tier_1_buckets.name: Marketing
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider positioning, messaging, and go-to-market.

tier_1_buckets.name: Support
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider customer support and service readiness.

tier_1_buckets.name: Metrics
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider measurable KPIs and monitoring.

tier_1_buckets.name: Experimentation
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider pilots, A/B tests, and validation.

tier_1_buckets.name: Product Strategy
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider strategic fit and long-term roadmap.

tier_1_buckets.name: Backlog
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider prioritization, technical debt, and backlog health.

tier_1_buckets.name: Process
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider workflow efficiency and bottlenecks.

tier_1_buckets.name: Governance
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider ownership, approvals, and decision rights.

tier_1_buckets.name: Finance
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider budgeting, forecasting, and financial impact.

tier_1_buckets.name: Compliance
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider mandatory standards and audits.

tier_1_buckets.name: Partnerships
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider ecosystem partners and external dependencies.

tier_1_buckets.name: Talent
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider skills, hiring, and capability gaps.

tier_1_buckets.name: Knowledge
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider documentation and knowledge management.

tier_1_buckets.name: Communication
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider stakeholder communication and reporting.

tier_1_buckets.name: Implementation
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider rollout approach, phases, and execution.

tier_1_buckets.name: Monitoring
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider observability, alerts, and operational metrics.

tier_1_buckets.name: Feedback
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider mechanisms for collecting and acting on feedback.

tier_1_buckets.name: Continuous Improvement
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider review cycles and ongoing optimization.

tier_1_buckets.name: Scenario Planning
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider best-case, worst-case, and likely scenarios.

tier_1_buckets.name: Decision Criteria
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider objective decision criteria and trade-offs.

tier_1_buckets.name: Constraints
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider known constraints and non-negotiables.

tier_1_buckets.name: Assumptions
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider assumptions that should be validated.

tier_1_buckets.name: Success Measures
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider how success will be objectively measured.

tier_1_buckets.name: Lessons Learned
tier_1_buckets.prompt: Consider relevant historical learnings and precedents.

tier_2_buckets.name: External Environment
tier_2_buckets.prompt: Consider the external environment affecting this objective. Evaluate political, economic, social, technological, legal, and environmental influences, along with emerging trends and constraints.

tier_2_buckets.name: Competitive Landscape
tier_2_buckets.prompt: Consider competitors, substitutes, supplier influence, buyer influence, barriers to entry, market rivalry, differentiation, and sources of competitive advantage.

tier_2_buckets.name: Strategic Positioning
tier_2_buckets.prompt: Consider internal strengths and weaknesses together with external opportunities and threats. Identify strategic choices and trade-offs.

tier_2_buckets.name: Growth Strategy
tier_2_buckets.prompt: Consider whether growth should come from existing markets, new markets, new products, partnerships, or diversification.

tier_2_buckets.name: Market Opportunity
tier_2_buckets.prompt: Assess market size, growth potential, attractiveness, maturity, and whitespace opportunities.

tier_2_buckets.name: Customer Needs
tier_2_buckets.prompt: Identify the customer's underlying jobs, pain points, motivations, expected outcomes, and unmet needs.

tier_2_buckets.name: Customer Segmentation
tier_2_buckets.prompt: Consider relevant customer segments, target audiences, positioning, and prioritization.

tier_2_buckets.name: Value Proposition
tier_2_buckets.prompt: Evaluate whether the proposed value is differentiated, meaningful, and aligned with customer priorities.

tier_2_buckets.name: Product Strategy
tier_2_buckets.prompt: Consider product vision, roadmap alignment, lifecycle stage, and strategic fit.

tier_2_buckets.name: Go-to-Market
tier_2_buckets.prompt: Consider channels, messaging, pricing, launch approach, partnerships, and commercial readiness.

tier_2_buckets.name: Pricing & Monetization
tier_2_buckets.prompt: Consider pricing models, willingness to pay, value capture, revenue streams, and commercial sustainability.

tier_2_buckets.name: Financial Viability
tier_2_buckets.prompt: Evaluate expected investment, costs, benefits, unit economics, profitability, ROI, and payback.

tier_2_buckets.name: Operational Readiness
tier_2_buckets.prompt: Consider people, processes, supply chain, infrastructure, support, and execution readiness.

tier_2_buckets.name: Technology Feasibility
tier_2_buckets.prompt: Consider architecture, scalability, performance, integration, technical risks, and implementation complexity.

tier_2_buckets.name: Data & AI
tier_2_buckets.prompt: Consider data availability, quality, governance, AI suitability, model limitations, and monitoring.
synonyms: ethical use of data and ai
risk from data quality or misuse

tier_2_buckets.name: Risk & Uncertainty
tier_2_buckets.prompt: Identify strategic, operational, financial, technical, regulatory, and execution risks together with mitigation plans.

tier_2_buckets.name: Governance & Compliance
tier_2_buckets.prompt: Consider ownership, approvals, policies, regulatory obligations, privacy, security, and audit requirements.

tier_2_buckets.name: Stakeholder Alignment
tier_2_buckets.prompt: Consider stakeholder expectations, incentives, influence, communication, and decision ownership.

tier_2_buckets.name: Execution Planning
tier_2_buckets.prompt: Consider milestones, dependencies, prioritization, resource allocation, and success measures.

tier_2_buckets.name: Continuous Improvement
tier_2_buckets.prompt: Consider feedback loops, KPIs, experimentation, lessons learned, and ongoing optimization.
